subject: SIG evidence request: consolidated scan parity + compensating control attestation
messages:
From: Michael Brown <michael.brown@fintrust.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@fintrust.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SIG evidence — scan parity + SLA/exception attestation

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As part of our SIG intake, we need: a consolidated package proving vulnerability-scan parity across Redwood-managed agents and the third-party scanner we run on our side, plus an attestation that CVEs with CVSS >= 7 are remediated within 30 days (or documented exceptions with compensating controls).

Specifically can you provide:
- A matrix mapping scanner source -> asset inventory (hostnames/IDs) showing coverage and last-scan timestamps
- A list of outstanding CVEs (>=7) and current remediation status (owner, ETA)
- Any documented exceptions for agents that cannot run (e.g., air-gapped nodes) and the compensating controls in place
- A signed attestation letter we can include in our SIG submission

If possible, please include machine-readable attachments (CSV/XLSX) and a short human summary. Our security team would like the package by EOD Wednesday (2026-12-16) to stay on the SIG review cadence.

Thanks,
Michael Brown
Head of Security Risk
FinTrust

--
FinTrust security@fintrust.com

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Michael Brown <michael.brown@fintrust.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SIG evidence — scan parity + SLA/exception attestation

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear list. We're attaching the requested machine-readable exports to this reply and summarizing the key points below.

Attachments: 1) redwood_infra_vuln_index_20261215.csv (master vuln index, per-host rows) 2) thirdparty_scan_parity_matrix_20261215.xlsx (coverage matrix)

Summary (top-level):
- Coverage: Our standard agent is installed on 98.6% of cloud-hosted nodes; parity matrix shows host-level alignment with your scanner where assets are shared. The parity sheet includes last-scan timestamps and matching finding IDs where we correlate by fingerprint/sha.
- Outstanding CVEs (>=7): We have 17 active findings across customer-controlled images and infra; ownership column shows assigned engineers and initial ETA windows.
- Legacy/air-gapped nodes: There are 12 air-gapped appliances that cannot run our agent due to network constraints. For those hosts we maintain a compensating control: network isolation + inbound-only proxying + WAF rule set (RFC-2746 based) and weekly perimeter scans. We document compensating controls in the matrix (column: compensating_control_notes).
- SLA/commitment: Our remediation SOP targets CVEs >=7 to be mitigated within 30 days from detection for Redwood-hosted infra. For customer-managed images and air-gapped appliances we list expected remediation paths and proposed exceptions.

Action items we propose:
1) We will sign an attestation letter acknowledging the above and the remediation SLO for Redwood-managed infra.
2) For air-gapped exceptions, we will provide a compensating-control attestation and weekly monitoring reports for the next 90 days while customers transition to agent-supported images.
3) We'll deliver the signed attestation by Monday (2026-12-20) after a quick internal review with Legal.

Marissa and Mina are copied to confirm operational details and the attestation language. Let me know if you need different export formats or additional metadata (e.g., proof-of-remediation links).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs:
- redwood_infra_vuln_index_20261215.csv (CSV, 12.1 MB)
- thirdparty_scan_parity_matrix_20261215.xlsx (XLSX, 450 KB)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Brown <michael.brown@fintrust.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SIG evidence — scan parity + SLA/exception attestation

Jonas / Mina — quick operational note and draft for the attestation.

I reviewed the CSV and parity matrix and suggested one small change: add a column for "mitigation_proof_link" (we can add a GDrive link per CVE where remediation evidence lives) so FinTrust can validate closures.

I've drafted an attestation template (attached: draft_attestation_fintrust_20261218.docx) with the following clauses:
- Scope: Redwood-managed inference infra (host pools) and the compensating control statement for identified air-gapped appliances
- SLA statement: CVEs with CVSS >= 7 will be remediated within 30 calendar days for Redwood-managed infra; customer-managed images follow customer remediation timelines unless under a Dedicated contract
- Monitoring cadence and evidence retention: weekly parity reports and one-off scan exports retained for 180 days

Please review the draft language and confirm redlines by COB Monday so Legal can sign Tuesday. If everyone agrees, we'll produce a PDF signed copy and the machine-readable logs (CSV) for FinTrust.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stub:
- draft_attestation_fintrust_20261218.docx (DOCX, 28 KB)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Michael Brown <michael.brown@fintrust.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SIG evidence — scan parity + compensating control attestation

Michael — thanks for your patience. Per Marissa's draft and Legal review, attached is the signed attestation and a final CVE action log. Key points:

- Signed attestation (attached): Redwood Inference attests to maintaining a vulnerability scan cadence and remediation SLOs as described in the draft. The attestation scope is Redwood-managed inference infrastructure (host pools) and the compensating control statement for the 12 identified air-gapped appliances.
- CVE action log (attached): cve_action_log_20261220.csv contains per-CVE rows with assigned owner, mitigation milestone timestamps, proof-of-remediation links, and expected closure dates. The log marks the 17 CVEs >=7 and shows 6 already remediated, 8 in-progress with ETA within 30 days, and 3 pending customer-image remediation.
- Next steps:
  1) We will push weekly parity exports to the shared folder (link sent to security@fintrust.com) every Friday for the next 12 weeks.
  2) For the air-gapped appliances, we will provide perimeter scan summaries and WAF rule snapshots weekly; we will work with your ops team if you want netflow proof of isolation.

Please confirm receipt and whether you need any notarized signatures or additional formatting to satisfy the SIG intake.

Attachments:
- signed_attestation_fintrust_20261220.pdf (PDF, 6 KB)
- cve_action_log_20261220.csv (CSV, 420 KB)

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

-----BEGIN SIGNED ATTESTATION (excerpt)-----
Redwood Inference hereby attests that, for the scope defined as Redwood-managed inference infrastructure used by FinTrust, Redwood operates an active vulnerability management program with weekly scan cadence across agented nodes, a documented parity process against proof-of-scan artifacts from customer scanners, and a remediation service-level objective to mitigate vulnerabilities with a CVSS score of 7.0 or greater within 30 calendar days of detection for Redwood-hosted assets. Exceptions for air-gapped appliances are documented and compensated by documented network isolation and perimeter controls, with weekly monitoring reports retained for 90 days.
-----END SIGNED ATTESTATION (excerpt)-----

Jonas — please let us know if Legal needs any additional statements. Michael — appreciate confirmation when this is cleared into your SIG packet.
